elements.name: Tabellenplatzhalter 5
elements.text:
May – December 2025 Research 1
Timeframe | Key Tasks | What I Will Do | Expected Output
Set up | May - June 2025 | Design & Planning | Finalize topic, framework, tagset, survey draft | Theory slides + 2-page methods memo
Annotation | July 2025 | Data Labeling | Freeze Tagbook v1.1 (T01–T06) | Tagbook slide + exemplar sheet
Pilot & Ratings Prep | August 2025 | Tag book & Annotation | Annotate a small subset; build construct scores. | Methodology slide + one pilot table
Methodology | September 2025 | Pilot & Ratings Prep | Join tags & ratings on (Prompt_Id + condition); | Completed reply_tags.csv + audit notes
Full Annotation | October 2025 | Collect User Ratings | Apply rules to all replies; QA edge cases | Analysis tables + simple figures
Analysis | Late Oct / Late Nov 2025 | Data Analysis | Compare tags + calculate. Summary result. | Presented deck + feedback action list
Finalization | Dec 2025 - February 2026 | Writing & Presentation | Robustness checks; revise visuals; draft short interim report | Interim report + slide deck v1 (Dec)
Schlusszeile | Project Design | Annotation & Survey | Data analysis | Finalization
